shots.focal_element: Stylised search query 'Best running shoes' with a magnifier icon, over a glowing horizon arc, with AI-answer brand chips appearing beneath it
shots.transition_other: none: opening shot of the video (anchors give no transition_in)
shots.typography: Large sentence-case geometric/grotesque sans, regular weight, normal tracking, white on black for the query; small sentence-case medium-weight labels inside dark rounded pills with a sparkle (AI) icon for the brand chips. Font guess (low confidence): a grotesque similar to Ahrefs' brand sans.
shots.what_happens: The query types on character by character (0.0-1.0 s), then lifts upward while the horizon glow brightens; five brand chips (Ecco, Hoka, Adidas, Salomon, Merrell) fade/scale in one after another in a scattered arc as the VO says the brand is 'invisible' if not in AI answers (w0-w14); at the end the query dims as the shot hands off.
shots.build_rebuild: On a black canvas with a radial blue-to-peach gradient dome at the bottom, type 'Best running shoes' next to a search icon at ~14 chars/s, then translate it up ~25% and stagger five dark pill chips with sparkle icons in (opacity 0 to 1 plus scale 0.9 to 1, ~0.25 s apart) at scattered positions across the dome.

shots.focal_element: Blue wireframe terrain landscape that becomes populated with platform logo orbs (Google, Reddit, YouTube, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, LinkedIn, X, Copilot), then the Ahrefs 'a' mark with a radar sweep
shots.transition_other: code-detected non-cut change (anchors: other); visually the gradient dome gives way to the 3D wireframe terrain, exact method not resolvable at 2 fps
shots.what_happens: A slow camera drift over a dark-blue wireframe terrain (w15-w28, 'new search landscape'). As the VO lists Google, AI platforms, Reddit, YouTube (w29-w36) the matching logo orbs pop onto the terrain at depth, while the sky brightens to a violet-peach horizon. On 'Enter Ahrefs' brand radar' (w37-w40) the Ahrefs mark appears in the sky with a circular radar ring and a blue-to-orange sweeping wedge; the platform orbs lift off the terrain and are gathered into orbit inside the radar ring as the camera tilts down.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a Three.js wireframe plane displaced by low-frequency noise with a slow forward dolly, pop circular logo sprites onto the surface in VO order (scale 0 to 1 with soft glow), then fade in a centred Ahrefs mark inside a thin circular ring with a rotating conic-gradient wedge and tween each logo sprite from the terrain to a fixed slot on the ring.

shots.focal_element: Circular 'radar' disc with the Ahrefs 'a' mark at the centre, platform logos (ChatGPT, Copilot, LinkedIn, Perplexity, YouTube, Google, X, Reddit, Gemini) arranged around it and a rotating blue-to-orange sweep wedge
shots.transition_other: code-detected non-cut change (anchors: other); the radar persists from s002 while the terrain background is replaced by the black-to-peach gradient dome (background dissolve)
shots.what_happens: Held centred radar: the gradient wedge sweeps clockwise roughly once per ~3 s around the ring, and each logo it passes brightens momentarily (the logos under the wedge dim/tint), while the VO delivers the positioning line '360-degree view of your brand across Google, AI search, and the entire web, all in one place' (w50-w67). The disc slowly scales up slightly over the shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Centre a semi-transparent circle with a thin blue stroke over a radial blue-to-peach gradient, place the Ahrefs mark in an inner ring and nine logo badges at fixed angles, and rotate a conic-gradient wedge (transparent to blue to orange edge) linearly at ~120 deg/s while applying a slow 1.0 to 1.08 scale to the whole group.

shots.focal_element: Ahrefs Brand Radar 'Overview' dashboard, then the Mentions line chart with an enlarged platform tab bar (AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot)
shots.typography: Product UI typography: small sentence-case regular sans for labels, larger medium-weight numerals for KPI values; the tab bar is scaled up as a callout with sentence-case regular labels and a highlighted active tab. Native app font, not identifiable with confidence.
shots.what_happens: Opens on a tilted, close 3D-perspective view of the overview cards (the share-of-voice donut and value appear to animate in, e.g. 0.1% to 19.1% to 24.1%), pulls back and flattens to the full overview with a brands table on 'It all starts with AI visibility' (w68-w73), then scrolls down to the Mentions chart. The platform tab bar is enlarged and the active tab steps AI Overviews to AI Mode to ChatGPT to Gemini to Perplexity to Copilot in time with 'six different AI platforms' (w74-w93), and the multi-brand line chart redraws for each platform, with a slight perspective tilt on the chart.
shots.build_rebuild: Show a dashboard screenshot inside a 3D-transformed plane that eases from rotateX/rotateY tilt and 1.6x scale to flat 1x, scroll it to the chart section, overlay a 1.4x-scaled clone of the tab bar and move the active-tab highlight across six tabs every ~1 s while crossfading the matching chart image under it.
